title: Automatic summaries
description: Generate a summary from saved capture text using the configured OpenCode provider.

AUTOSUMMARY_ENABLED.description: Generate a summary from saved capture text using the configured OpenCode provider.

AUTOSUMMARY_MODEL.description: Optional provider/model. Blank uses the existing OpenCode default model.

AUTOSUMMARY_TIMEOUT.description: Total time allowed for one OpenCode request in seconds.

AUTOSUMMARY_PROMPT.description: Additional instructions for the generated content.

AUTOSUMMARY_INPUTS.description: Saved snapshot paths or glob patterns, in preference order. The first nonempty source is used. No pages are fetched.
